description: Change any of: name, voice, greeting, instructions, owner_name, owner_phone, timezone, notify_email, agent_email, morning_brief (daily digest on/off), morning_brief_hour (0–23 local), forward_email, forward_mode (relay|raw|off), sms_opt_in, answer_rings (0|1|2). Only the fields you pass change.

answer_rings.description: When the line picks up an inbound call: 0 right away, 1 at the end of the first ring (default), 2 after two rings. Forwarded missed calls always answer right away.

greeting.description: What the line says first on every call it answers, including calls forwarded from the owner's mobile. Up to 300 characters. Empty restores the default.

instructions.description: Standing context for every call, in plain English. Up to 12,000 characters (about 2,000 words); a longer text is refused with an error, never trimmed.

morning_brief.description: Daily morning brief email (calls, texts, bookings, what is waiting on the owner). Default on.

morning_brief_hour.description: Local hour for the brief. Default 7.

plan.description: Not changeable here. A plan change alters what the owner's card is charged, so the owner does it under Settings, Plan. Sending a different plan returns an error with that link.

pronunciations.description: How to say names, e.g. { word: 'Fathollahi', sayAs: 'fat-oh-LAH-hee' }.

voice_style.description: How the line carries itself on calls.

name: update_settings
title: Update settings
